title: Red Hat Hardened Images gain AWS Inspector and ECR scanning, OTel 2.0 telco AI lands
summary: Red Hat's Friday Five notes that AWS InspectorScan API and ECR Basic scanning now support Red Hat Hardened Images, giving container security teams vulnerability alerts and supply-chain verification against the same images they already pull. Separately, Red Hat, AT&T, AMD, Dell, Microsoft and GSMA released OTel 2.0, a domain-specific AI model for telecommunications built on the open-source SDG Hub to convert technical standards into synthetic training data.
